title: Audit sweep: truncated dock-seg chips on 30 pages (Media·Comp·Styles·Assets et al)
notes: Pre-existing before the shared-DS primitives batch (verified by stash + resweep on 2026-08-23: identical failures with and without the batch). audit-sweep.js reports 'truncated chip' + 'uneven chips' for .seg controls inside .pdock/.dgrp-b on ~30 pages at 1280x900, e.g. the Library scope seg. Either the seg auto-fit --segmin measurement regressed after the July rebuild or the sweep measures before photonz-ds.js sets --segmin in iframes. Reproduce with shared/audit-sweep.js, then fix whichever is broken (component or sweep timing).

log.note: Reproduction attempt: ran shared/audit-sweep.js verbatim in Chrome over all 90 pages at 1280x900 (three batches of 30). Result: zero issues, 74 dock/panel segs measured. The failure does not reproduce.

Root cause of the stale report: commit 9b72976 (Aug 22 23:35, 'dock segs stop ellipsizing labels') both rewrote the dock seg geometry (natural-width minmax(0,max-content) columns in segmented.css, collapse-to-menu in segmented.js) and rewrote audit-sweep.js (dropped the 'uneven chips' check since unequal widths are now by design, added the visibility filter). The ~30-page failure list this task cites came from the pre-9b72976 sweep. Spot-checked the named Library scope seg on ds-build-wt/brush-library/components: all labels render whole, clip=0; brush-library's 7-chip catseg correctly collapses to its menu.

Cleanup shipped: dock.js still measured every dock seg's widest label into --segmin, but nothing consumes that var anymore (verified repo-wide grep) and it is exactly what misled this task's hypothesis. Removed the dead block, corrected the stale --segmin paragraph in AGENTS.md VR6, rebuilt shared/dist. Re-swept 20 seg-heaviest pages after the change: still zero issues.

Does not reproduce: full 90-page sweep at 1280x900 returns zero issues (74 segs). Fixed by 9b72976 (natural-width dock seg columns + collapse-to-menu + sweep rewrite) before this task was filed from a stale sweep run.
